source: ECMWF ERA5 hourly single levels (reanalysis-era5-single-levels) via Copernicus Climate Data Store

provenance.extraction: Values decoded from the NetCDF4/HDF5 data chunks of the source file (shuffle + deflate filters) and rounded to 4 decimals. Cross-checked: nearest-cell values at (29.0N, 89.0W) equal the ERA5 values previously hard-coded in server.ts (U10 1.697/2.077, V10 1.591/1.658 m/s at 14:00/15:00 UTC). Regenerate with: python scripts/extract_era5_field.py
provenance.temporal_coverage_note: Only 2 hourly fields (14:00 and 15:00 UTC) were downloaded. Outside this window the drift engine holds the nearest field constant and labels those steps PERSISTED.
provenance.spatial_coverage_note: Grid covers 28.75-29.0N, 89.5-89.0W. Positions outside the grid are clamped to the nearest edge and labelled EDGE_CLAMPED.
